name: Boizenburg/Elbe (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Boizenburg/Elbe (a yellow castle with a domed tower on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Boizenburg/Elbe; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Boizenburg arms — yellow castle on blue
